scripts.localhost-stop-all: npm run localhost-stop-cd; npm run localhost-stop-bridge; rm -f killCache.txt
scripts.localhost-bridge: pushd `node pkgdir.js axona-bridge`; (BRIDGE_REGION_LABEL= BRIDGE_REGION=bridge npm start &); popd; sleep 3
scripts.localhost-hosts: REGIONS=1 PER=9 PORTALS=$((REGIONS * PER)) SLEEP=$(((1 + PORTALS) * 3)); pushd `node pkgdir.js @yz-social/civildefense.io`; (npm start -- --bridgeUrl ws://localhost:8080 --regionsStart 80 --excludedRegions 81 84 --perRegionCount ${PER} --nPortals ${PORTALS} &); popd; sleep ${SLEEP}
scripts.localhost-start: npm run localhost-bridge; npm run localhost-hosts
scripts.localhost-oneshot: npm run localhost-start; npm run localhost-check && npm run localhost-stop-all
scripts.localhost-twoshot: npm run localhost-start; npm run localhost-check && npm run localhost-check && npm run localhost-stop-all
scripts.localhost-hosts-us: NREGIONS=`echo ${REGIONS_ARRAY:-80} | xargs | wc -w` PER=${PER_REGION:-9} PORTALS=$((NREGIONS * PER)) SLEEP=$(((1 + PORTALS) * 3)); pushd `node pkgdir.js @yz-social/civildefense.io`; (npm start -- --bridgeUrl ${BRIDGE_URL:-ws://localhost:8080} --regionsStart `echo ${REGIONS_ARRAY:-80} | awk '{print $1}'` --excludedRegions 81 84 --perRegionCount ${PER} --nPortals ${PORTALS} &); popd; sleep ${SLEEP}
scripts.localhost-oneshot-us: npm run localhost-bridge; npm run localhost-hosts-us; npm run localhost-check-us && npm run localhost-stop-all
scripts.dailyFire: DHT=0 npm start -- --throttleMS 75 --bridgeUrl wss://civildefense.io --regions 4c 4d 52 53 54 80 86 87 88 89 --tags fire --fireScope us --kill false --recordKill false
scripts.kdailyFire: DHT=1 npm start -- --throttleMS 75 --bridgeUrl wss://testnet.axona.net --regions 80 --tags fire --fireScope us --kill false --recordKill false
scripts.testnet-0x80: pushd node_modules/@yz-social/civildefense.io; (LAT_LNG='37,-122' npm start -- --bridgeUrl ws://testnet.axona.net --nPortals 6 &); popd
scripts.mainnet-0x80: pushd node_modules/@yz-social/civildefense.io; (LAT_LNG='37,-122' npm start -- --bridgeUrl ws://bridge.axona.net --nPortals 6 &); popd
scripts.testnet-check-80: LAT_LNG='40,-75' npm start -- --bridgeUrl ws://testnet.axona.net --disconnectAfterPublish false --regions 80 --fireScope reuse-previous
scripts.basic-mainnet-check: EVENT_VERSION=`date -Iseconds` LAT_LNG="40,-75" npm start -- --bridgeUrl ws://bridge.axona.net --subStaggerMs 200 --disconnectAfterPublish false --pauseBeforeDeleteS 10 --pauseBeforePublishS 10 --pauseAfterPublishS 20 --includeImages false --tags floodTest fireTest iceTest
scripts.basic-testnet-check: EVENT_VERSION=`date -Iseconds` LAT_LNG="40,-75" npm start -- --bridgeUrl ws://testnet.axona.net --subStaggerMs 200 --disconnectAfterPublish false --pauseBeforeDeleteS 10 --pauseBeforePublishS 10 --pauseAfterPublishS 20 --includeImages false --tags floodTest fireTest iceTest
scripts.basic-testnet-diagnostics: EVENT_VERSION=`date -Iseconds` LAT_LNG="40,-75"  npm start -- --bridgeUrl ws://testnet.axona.net --subStaggerMs 200 --disconnectAfterPublish false --pauseBeforeDeleteS 10 --pauseBeforePublishS 10 --pauseAfterPublishS 20 --verbose --logConnectivity --lookupFailedTopics --metricsS 20 --includeImages false --tags floodTest fireTest iceTest
